entities.summary: Abraham's Well is a historical water well in Beersheba, Israel, associated with the biblical narrative of Abraham. Its structure houses the archaeology museum of Beersheba. Abraham's well is a museum, established in 1948. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
